dek: The Environmental Protection Department (EPD) today (August 7) released the latest grading of water quality for 39 gazetted beaches (see Note 1) and one non-gazetted beach (see Note 2). Eight beaches were rated as Good (Grade 1), 27 as Fair (Grade 2) and five as Poor (Grade 3). Grade 1 beaches are: Hap Mun Bay Beach* R
